body.title: Django REST Framework (DRF) Developer
body.description: As a Django REST Framework (DRF) Developer, you will play a crucial role in developing and maintaining RESTful APIs and web applications using the Django framework. Your primary responsibility will be to design, implement, and optimize APIs that provide seamless integration between front-end and back-end systems while ensuring scalability, security, and performance.
body.requirements:
1. Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field (or equivalent experience).
  2. Proficiency in Python programming language.
  3. Strong understanding of Django framework and Django REST Framework (DRF).
  4. Experience in designing and developing RESTful APIs and web services.
  5. Familiarity with relational databases and SQL queries.
  6. Knowledge of authentication and authorization mechanisms such as token-based authentication, OAuth, or JWT.
  7. Experience with version control systems (e.g., Git) and collaborative development workflows.
  8. Excellent problem-solving skills and attention to detail.
  9. Strong communication and collaboration skills.
  10. Experience with front-end technologies (HTML, CSS, JavaScript) is a plus.
body.responsibilities:
1. Design, develop, and maintain RESTful APIs using Django REST Framework (DRF) to support web and mobile applications.
  2. Collaborate with front-end developers, UX/UI designers, and other stakeholders to understand project requirements and implement API endpoints accordingly.
  3. Implement authentication and authorization mechanisms such as token-based authentication, OAuth, or JWT to secure API endpoints.
  4. Optimize API performance through efficient database queries, caching strategies, and other optimization techniques.
  5. Write clean, well-documented, and maintainable code following best practices and coding standards.
  6. Implement automated tests for API endpoints to ensure reliability and stability.
  7. Troubleshoot and debug issues in API functionality and performance.
  8. Work with relational databases (e.g., PostgreSQL, MySQL) to design schemas and optimize database interactions.
  9. Collaborate with DevOps engineers to deploy and manage APIs in production environments.
  10. Stay up-to-date with the latest developments in Django, Django REST Framework, and related technologies to continuously improve skills and stay ahead of industry trends.
